values.review_scope: Review only #5352 exact-revision handoff, issue-local lifecycle records, focused validators, evidence, and publication boundaries.
review_prompts: Are all issue/PR/head/merge claims row-bound and ancestral to the exact baseline?
Are lifecycle cards and retained validation current and truthful?
Do non-claims prevent planning and launch artifacts from becoming implementation claims?
Is the PR diff limited to the handoff and issue-local lifecycle evidence?
